title: Mentored two junior developers and designed a platform at Gisoft
evidence: At Gisoft I led a project with a team of three developers, two of them just starting out. It was a platform for mobile top-ups, bill payments and streaming subscriptions, where people and businesses signed up and invited others: the network earned a commission on their own purchases and on those of everyone they brought in. I gathered requirements with the clients, guided the new developers through the technical side and how the platform worked, and defined the system design: a monolith with Laravel, Angular and Ionic.
